verdict.line: You lose if you let Sion toggle E and farm autos into a long trade with R up; you win if you force the fight while his W shield is down and his R is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Sion has no mobility and no shield while his W (Death's Caress) is on its 8s cooldown, so every window after he pops or loses that shield is a clean opening for your E (Footwork) dash and Q (Ntofo Strikes) stack-pull. The 46.5% win rate over 71 games despite your measured lane and solo-kill edge comes from his level 6+ Cannibalism sustain and Enrage toggle turning even trades into attrition wins for him if you let the fight run long.

theirWindow.when: R up and E toggled active
theirWindow.what: Once Sion hits 6 and flips Enrage on, his autos drain his own health for AD and his R leeches it back with bonus attack speed — do not stand in an extended trade here, his sustain scales faster than yours mid-fight.

yourWindow.when: his W shield just popped or expired
yourWindow.what: The instant the shield detonates or he burns it reactivating early, he has zero damage mitigation for 8 seconds — dash in with E (Footwork), land your 2nd Q stack for the shockwave pull, and chain into W (Path Maker) for the stun before he can reset.

powerCurve.note: E dash-shield lets you dictate trades
Iceborn slow matches his Enrage damage

start.why: 81% pick rate at 45.6% win over 68 games — the extra sustain offsets Sion's Q (Cryptic Gaze) poke at 550 range, which outranges both your Q and E.

boots.why: 73.1% pick at 42.1% win — Sion's whole kit after level 6 is repeated basic attacks (Enrage procs, Cannibalism leech), and flat auto reduction cuts both.

core.why: The slow proc on your Q (Ntofo Strikes) line hit lets you stick to a champion with zero gap-close of his own.
Shield-on-ability-use absorbs the burst from his stun-locked Q (Cryptic Gaze) openings.
Stacking resistances scale directly against his Enrage auto-attack AD stacking in extended fights.

situational.when: he's stacked max HP from E (Enrage) kills and his R (Cannibalism) healing is carrying fights
he's building into pure auto-attack Enrage stacking rather than a bruiser path
his R (Cannibalism) attack speed buff is winning you prolonged trades

runes.keystoneWhy: 44.4% pick at 22% — the proc-on-attack healing and permanent health growth matches Sion's own HP-scaling kit in a long lane where neither side burst-kills early.

summoners.why: 84.2% pick at 47.8% win — Teleport lets you reset after shoving with Iceborn waveclear and still punish his E (Enrage) farm-reliant scaling elsewhere on the map.

playing.title: Bait the shield, then commit
playing.detail: Throw a poke to force Sion's W (Death's Caress) shield up, then wait out the 8s cooldown or his early detonation before diving in — he has no other defensive tool.

playing.title: Track the Enrage toggle
playing.detail: When his E (Enrage) is on, he's trading his own health for AD on every auto — if you see his HP bar ticking down from autos alone, he's already lower than he looks.

playing.title: Respect pre-6 Q range
playing.detail: His Q (Cryptic Gaze) stuns at 550 range, farther than your E (Footwork) at 525 or Q (Ntofo Strikes) at 450 — don't walk up for a stack before baiting it out.

playing.title: Stack Q before all-in
playing.detail: Land two Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits to trigger the shockwave pull before you commit E or W — it closes the gap on a melee champion with no dash.

playing.title: Don't extend fights after his 6
playing.detail: Once his R (Cannibalism) is up, every second of auto-trading heals him and ramps his attack speed — land your stun/knockback chain and disengage rather than slug it out.

playing.title: Save R for isolation
playing.detail: Your R (All Out) knocks him through walls and separates him from minions he'd otherwise farm for permanent HP via his E — use it to pick fights away from the wave.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical breakdown and trade timing are my own tactical reading, not sourced from the data.
